description: Here is a photo of a pygmy hippopotamus pair at the Mount Kenya Wildlife Conservancy. The two were a gift to the people of Kenya (from a country in West Africa - I forget which) and are better cared for here than when they were back in Nairobi. Pygmy hippoptomus' really enjoy having their earlobes massaged. It's a known fact that it makes the hairs on their backs stand up. Chuck @ UPDmedia.com ( talk ) 18:37, 1 June 2008 (UTC)
